zh: 在一段单调（不增或不减）的连续元素里，首尾之差的绝对值就等于各相邻差绝对值之和，所以单调段的内部点都可以删掉。
先把连续相等的值合并成一个；如果只剩一个值，答案就是1。否则必须保留首尾以及所有由升转降或由降转升的转折点，其余元素都能删掉。
去掉相邻重复后得到序列b；若长度为1输出1；否则答案从2开始，对每个内部位置i，若b[i]−b[i−1]与b[i+1]−b[i]符号相反就加1，最后输出答案。
en: Inside a monotone run (non-increasing or non-decreasing), the absolute difference between its ends equals the sum of its adjacent absolute differences, so the inner points of a monotone run can all be deleted.

First merge runs of equal values into one; if a single value remains, the answer is 1. Otherwise the two ends and every point where a rise turns into a fall or a fall into a rise must stay, and everything else can go.

Remove adjacent duplicates to get b; if its length is 1 print 1; otherwise start the answer at 2 and add 1 for every inner position i where b[i] - b[i-1] and b[i+1] - b[i] have opposite signs; print the answer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Remove consecutive equal values. If only one value remains the answer is 1; otherwise keep the first and last elements and every point where a strict rise turns into a fall or the other way round.

## Proof of correctness

Within a monotone run, the difference of the endpoints equals the sum of all adjacent differences, so deleting interior points does not change the target. Skipping a strict turning point makes the triangle inequality strict, losing part of the sum, and no other deletion can make up for it, so every turning point must be kept; when the total variation is non-zero, the first and last extreme values must each be kept as well.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n).
